job.title: Software Engineer II
job.pay_full: $152,000 – $178,300 a year base pay, plus an annual incentive (reference value 15%)

details.about: The Coca-Cola Company's product organization builds the digital products behind its North America Operating Unit: customer journeys, service delivery, sales workflows and the platforms that connect them. As a Software Engineer II you'll be a core member of a small, empowered cross-functional team with Product Management and Design, building software that solves real customer problems.
duties: Work with Product Management and Design to understand customer problems and shape solutions, from ideation to prototypes
Define and guide the technical approach, architecture and system design for your team's product area
Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, scalability, maintainability and cost, and surface technical risks early
Lead delivery of high-quality solutions with strong testing, observability and CI/CD, through reviews and hands-on coding
Define and track success metrics with Product and Data, and use data and experiments to guide decisions
Help shape engineering standards and best practices across teams
needs: Experience building and shipping production-grade applications
Proficiency in modern frontend and backend languages and frameworks
Experience with APIs, distributed systems and cloud environments
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
nice: Work on cross-functional product teams and in product discovery or solution design
Technical leadership within a team (formal or informal)
Modern engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, observability
details.benefits: Base pay $152,000 – $178,300 a year (United States); pay offered may vary with geography, knowledge, skills and experience. Annual incentive reference value: 15%. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.
notes: Coca-Cola will not sponsor employment visas for this position; applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US full time

yt_title: Coca-Cola Is Hiring: Software Engineer II | Atlanta, GA | $152K–$178K

scenes.head: The role
lines: Now hiring in Atlanta! Coca-Cola wants a Software Engineer Two to build the digital products behind its North America business.

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll work with product and design to solve real customer problems, guide your team's architecture, and ship high-quality software with strong testing and monitoring.
You'll also set success metrics and use them to decide what to improve next.

lines: You'll need five years of software engineering, full stack skills across frontend and backend, and experience with A P Is, distributed systems, and the cloud.
